Supplier Onboarding and Procurement Services Schedule

Document reference BCS-SCH-2026-041. This schedule is issued by BigCo Sourcing, with offices at 9 Alderfern Quay, Leeds LS11 8BW (the "Buyer"), to the supplier named in the onboarding portal at the time of acceptance (the "Vendor"). Acceptance occurs when the Vendor completes registration in the portal and confirms its category assignments.

A. Scope of engagement

The Vendor is admitted to the Buyer's approved supplier panel for the categories listed in the portal, which may include office consumables, facilities maintenance, and ancillary logistics. Admission to the panel does not guarantee any volume of business, and the Buyer is under no obligation to issue purchase orders. Individual engagements are commissioned through statements of work issued under this schedule.

B. Onboarding requirements

Before the first statement of work is issued, the Vendor must upload valid insurance certificates, evidence of relevant accreditations, and bank details verified through the portal's confirmation workflow. The Vendor must also nominate a service delivery manager and a deputy, and keep their contact details current. The Buyer may suspend panel admission where onboarding records lapse or become inaccurate.

C. Deliverables and acceptance

Deliverables under each statement of work are deemed accepted ten working days after delivery unless the Buyer records a rejection in the portal describing the defect in reasonable detail. Rejected deliverables must be corrected and redelivered within the cure window stated in the relevant statement of work, or, if none is stated, within fifteen working days.

D. Service levels

The Vendor shall meet the service levels in Annex SL-1, including acknowledgement of Buyer queries within one working day, resolution of priority-one incidents within four hours, and monthly service reporting by the fifth working day of the following month. Persistent failure to meet service levels entitles the Buyer to reduce the Vendor's category assignments or remove the Vendor from the panel.

E. Invoicing and settlement

The Vendor invoices monthly in arrears through the portal, quoting the relevant statement of work reference. Settlement runs are executed on the twenty-eighth day of each month for invoices approved before the twentieth day. Queries raised on an invoice pause settlement of that invoice only.

F. Records and audit

The Vendor shall retain delivery records, incident logs, and timesheets for six years and make them available to the Buyer on five working days' notice for audit purposes. Audits may occur no more than twice in any calendar year unless a material discrepancy has been identified.

G. Changes to this schedule

The Buyer may update this schedule by posting a revised version in the portal with at least thirty days' advance notice. Continued participation in the panel after the effective date of a revision constitutes acceptance of the revised schedule.

H. Panel withdrawal

Either side may withdraw from the panel arrangement by giving sixty days' notice through the portal. Withdrawal does not affect statements of work already in progress, which continue to be governed by this schedule until their deliverables are accepted.

I. Law and forum

This schedule is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
